::: {#hero-heading}

Active Analytics is an independent consultancy specialising in reproducible
analysis of transport, air quality, and road safety data. We build evidence
that stands up to scrutiny — from dispersion modelling and meteorological
normalisation to STATS19 collision analysis and TAG-compliant appraisal.

[Learn more about what we do &rarr;](services.qmd)
